import sys

def max_sum_partition(n, d):
    prefix_sum = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        prefix_sum[i] = prefix_sum[i - 1] + d[i - 1]
    
    max_sum = 0
    seen_sums = {}
    
    for i in range(n + 1):
        current_sum = prefix_sum[i]
        
        if current_sum in seen_sums:
            j = seen_sums[current_sum]
            sum1 = current_sum
            sum2 = prefix_sum[i] - prefix_sum[j]
            sum3 = prefix_sum[n] - prefix_sum[i]
            if sum1 == sum3:
                max_sum = max(max_sum, sum1)
        
        seen_sums[prefix_sum[i]] = i
    
    return max_sum

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    d = list(map(int, data[1:]))
    
    result = max_sum_partition(n, d)
    print(result)
